pet.state.loading.en: The pet is on its way…

pet.renderer.unavailable.en: This pet needs a renderer ({renderer}) that is not available in this build.
pet.renderer.unavailable.zh: 这只宠物需要的渲染器（{renderer}）在当前版本不可用。

pet.live2d.core-missing.en: Live2D Cubism Core is not installed: place the official live2dcubismcore.min.js under $DSH_HOME/pets/.runtime/ and refresh (see the pet plugin README).
pet.live2d.core-missing.zh: Live2D 核心未安装：请把官方 live2dcubismcore.min.js 放入 $DSH_HOME/pets/.runtime/ 后刷新（步骤见宠物插件 README）。

pet.live2d.vendor-missing.en: The Live2D component is missing; please update the pet plugin.
pet.live2d.vendor-missing.zh: Live2D 组件缺失，请升级宠物插件。

pet.live2d.load-failed.en: The Live2D model failed to load; check the pet directory is complete.
pet.live2d.load-failed.zh: Live2D 模型加载失败，请检查该宠物目录的完整性。

pet.openSessionHint.en: Click to jump to this session

pet.moreSessions.zh: 展开其余 {n} 个会话的气泡

settings.description.en: Pick a pet and tune its display layout.
settings.description.zh: 选择宠物并调整它的显示布局。

settings.petHint.en: Choose which pet shows. Names are stored per pet; rename from the pet hover panel.
settings.petHint.zh: 选择显示哪只宠物；每只宠物独立命名，可在宠物悬浮面板改名。

settings.enabledHint.en: When off, the pet hides and polling stops; re-enable it here.
settings.enabledHint.zh: 关闭后隐藏宠物并停止轮询，可在设置里重新启用。

settings.decorationHint.en: Show ornaments like the spouting whale inside the pet status bubbles; when off, bubbles stay text-only.
settings.decorationHint.zh: 在宠物状态气泡里显示喷水鲸鱼等状态装饰；关闭后气泡只剩文字。

settings.statusBubblesHint.en: The pet's own session/status bubbles (thinking, using ...). Turning them off leaves only bubbles a third-party plugin pushes through the announcement contract, plus the interaction feedback bubble; on by default.
settings.statusBubblesHint.zh: 宠物自带的会话／状态气泡（正在思考、正在使用 xxx）。关掉后只剩第三方插件通过公告契约推送的气泡与互动反馈气泡；默认开启。

settings.visibleHint.en: When off, the pet hides; summon it again from the input row.
settings.visibleHint.zh: 关闭后宠物隐藏，可从聊天输入区重新召唤。

settings.bubbleScaleHint.en: Status, whisper, and usage bubbles scale with the pet automatically; this multiplies that result (0.5–2, default 1). The rendered text stays between 10px and 24px.
settings.bubbleScaleHint.zh: 状态、碎碎念与用量气泡的字号会随宠物大小自动缩放；这一项是在此基础上再乘一个倍率（0.5–2，默认 1）。字号本身不小于 10px、不大于 24px。

settings.rightHint.en: Horizontal inset from the viewport right edge.
settings.rightHint.zh: 距视口右边缘的水平内缩距离。

settings.bottomHint.en: Vertical inset from the viewport bottom edge.
settings.bottomHint.zh: 距视口底边的垂直内缩距离。

settings.notExposed.en: This DSH version does not expose this plugin's settings namespace to the configuration page, so the form is unavailable. Edit $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml directly, or confirm that the plugin owning the namespace is mounted with its settings domain and restart.
settings.notExposed.zh: 当前 DSH 版本未向设置页暴露本插件的配置命名空间，表单不可用。可编辑 $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml 直接配置，或确认提供该命名空间的插件已挂载其设置域并重启。

settings.saveFailed.en: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
settings.saveFailed.zh: 部署未接受这些值，已保留供你修改。

settings.invalidNumber.en: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
settings.invalidNumber.zh: 请输入数字，留空则使用默认值。
